violet-pulse.$description: Violet Pulse — Primary CTAs, active icons, brand glow accents — the single chromatic accent in the system; everything else defers to it

indigo-ink.$description: Indigo Ink — Link text, secondary text emphasis, and accent strokes where violet would be too loud

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Soft tinted backgrounds for highlighted callouts and subtle surface differentiation

iris-glow.$description: Iris Glow — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ledger-green.$description: Ledger Green — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary canvas, card surfaces, button fills, and elevated surface layer

bone.$description: Bone — Recessed card surfaces and subtle panel backgrounds one step off white

fog.$description: Fog — Disabled surface fills, table row alternates, and recessed UI regions

silver.$description: Silver — Inset borders, button outlines, and shadow-stack fills for elevation

marble.$description: Marble — Warm cream accent for announcement bars and subtle highlight bands

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary heading and body text — near-black with a barely-warm tint

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary headings, emphasized body text, and list accents

iron.$description: Iron — Default body text and the most-used text color across the system

steel.$description: Steel — Muted helper text, navigation labels, and secondary table text

smoke.$description: Smoke — Placeholder text, disabled labels, and tertiary table cells

ash.$description: Ash — Default hairline border — the structural backbone of the entire UI; the most-used color in the system

mist.$description: Mist — Cooler border for inputs, dividers, and sections needing visual separation from Ash

olive-gray.$description: Olive Gray — SVG illustration stroke and fill — the default for vector graphics in content

noir.$description: Noir — Icon fills and contrast anchors where pure black is required

twk-lausanne.$description: Primary UI typeface — all body text, navigation, buttons, labels, and most headings from 8px to 24px. A humanist sans with open apertures that stays legible at 10–12px in dense tables and form chrome.

moderat-serif.$description: Editorial display serif used only on the largest marketing headlines (h1). Light weight at 40–46px with aggressive -0.025em tracking — the contrast against the humanist sans signals premium editorial tone and breaks the product-UI pattern.

sf-mono.$description: Monospaced micro-text for API references, code snippets, and technical annotations at 10px. Rare and deliberate — appears only where machine-readable content is shown.
